title: Umgcini Womqondiso KaThixo
intro: Ngaphakathi kwindawo engcwele engcwele, umphefumlo osikelelekileyo wakhuliswa phantsi kokhathalelo lukaThixo. Lo mntu wayemiselwe ukudlala indima ebalulekileyo kwisiganeko esimangalisayo, esiba bubungqina bamandla nobulumko buka-Allah obungenamda. Uhambo lwabo lwatyhila inyaniso enzulu, lwafaka umngeni kwiimbono kwaye lwamisela uphawu olulodwa kubo bonke abantu.
clues: Ndakhethwa kwaye ndahlanjululwa nguAllah ngaphezu kwabo bonke abafazi bexesha lam.
Ndabekwa phantsi kolwalathiso lomprofeti olilungisa, owafumana inkxaso ngokungummangaliso kwigumbi lam lokuthandaza.
Ndazihlukanisa nosapho lwam ndaya kwindawo eyimfihlo yokunqula uAllah.
Ingelosi yabonakala kum ikwimo yomntu ogqibeleleyo, izisa iindaba zonyana omsulwa, nangona ndandingazi mntu wesilisa.
Emva kwentlungu yokubeleka, ndayalelwa ukuba ndishukumise isiqu somthi wesundu ukuze ndifumane ukutya okutsha.
Ndathi ndakubuyela ebantwini bam ndithwele usana lwam, bandibuza imibuzo, kodwa unyana wam oselusana wathetha ngokungummangaliso esesesibelekweni ukuze andikhusele.
